query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS service_bids (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  request_id INT NOT NULL,
  office_id INT NOT NULL,
  proposed_price DECIMAL(10,2) NOT NULL,
  currency VARCHAR(3) DEFAULT 'OMR' NOT NULL,
  estimated_duration VARCHAR(100),
  cover_letter TEXT NOT NULL,
  methodology TEXT,
  portfolio JSON,
  status ENUM('pending', 'accepted', 'rejected', 'withdrawn') DEFAULT 'pending' NOT NULL,
  viewed_by_customer BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE,
  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  INDEX request_idx (request_id),
  INDEX office_idx (office_id),
  INDEX status_idx (status)
)
